runner.name: p933_native_audit.py
runner.source:
"""Replay supplied P9-3.3 evidence with native repository providers only."""
import argparse
import base64
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import platform
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--repo', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--bundle', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root, output = args.repo.resolve(), args.output.resolve()
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    scopes = ['src', 'tests', 'specs', 'pyproject.toml', 'README.md', 'LICENSE']
    def git(*argv):
        return subprocess.check_output(['git', *argv], cwd=root, text=True)
    paths = git('ls-files', '--', *scopes).splitlines()
    hashes = {p: digest((root / p).read_bytes()) for p in paths}
    assert not git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '--', *scopes)
    blob = args.bundle.read_bytes()
    inputs = {
        'external_bundle': {'name': args.bundle.name, 'sha256': digest(blob),
                            'encoding': 'base64', 'data': base64.b64encode(blob).decode()},
        'runner': {'name': Path(__file__).name, 'source': Path(__file__).read_text()},
        'subject': {'base_commit': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').strip(),
                    'patch': git('diff', '--binary', 'HEAD', '--', *scopes),
                    'tracked_file_sha256': hashes},
        'scope': 'Native replay; original qualified run remains unchanged in the supplied bundle.',
        'support_transformation': 'For mutation_controls.py and characterize.py only, remove the exact first line import bootstrap; prepend native repository and unchanged stress_core paths. No production/provider adaptation.',
    }
    (output / 'inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(inputs, indent=2) + '\n')
    record = {'schema': 'phase9_leaf_run_v1', 'iteration_id': 'P9-3.3',
              'started_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'status': 'running',
              'subject_inputs': 'inputs.json', 'python': sys.version,
              'platform': platform.platform(),
              'dependencies': sorted(f"{d.metadata['Name']}=={d.version}" for d in importlib.metadata.distributions()),
              'replay_argv': ['<venv-python>', '<extracted-runner>', '--repo', '<checkout>', '--bundle', '<decoded-bundle>', '--output', '<fresh-output>'],
              'commands': [], 'claim_ceiling': 'Local boundary evidence; no acceptance, full beats, root certification or runtime support.'}
    def retain():
        (output / 'run.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
    def run(argv, cwd):
        print('Executing', ' '.join(argv), flush=True)
        result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=1200)
        record['commands'].append({'argv': argv, 'cwd': str(cwd), 'exit_status': result.returncode,
                                   'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr})
        retain()
        if result.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError('Audit command failed; see run.json')
        return result.stdout
    retain()
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='p933-native-audit-') as temp:
            scratch = Path(temp)
            extracted = scratch / 'external'
            with zipfile.ZipFile(args.bundle) as archive:
                manifest = json.loads(archive.read('P9-3.3-audit-bundle-manifest.json'))
                entries = {e['path']: e for e in manifest['files']}
                assert len(entries) == len(manifest['files'])
                assert len(archive.namelist()) == len(set(archive.namelist()))
                assert set(archive.namelist()) == set(entries) | {'P9-3.3-audit-bundle-manifest.json'}
                for info in archive.infolist():
                    name = PurePosixPath(info.filename)
                    assert not name.is_absolute() and '..' not in name.parts
                    assert not stat.S_ISLNK(info.external_attr >> 16)
                    data = archive.read(info)
                    if info.filename in entries:
                        entry = entries[info.filename]
                        assert len(data) == entry['bytes'] and digest(data) == entry['sha256']
                    target = extracted / info.filename
                    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    target.write_bytes(data)
            native = scratch / 'native'
            run([sys.executable, str(extracted / 'P9-3.3-independent-stress-tests.py'),
                 '--repo', str(root), '--output', str(native)], scratch)
            actual = {name: json.loads((native / name).read_text()) for name in
                      ('environment-and-subject.json', 'stress-results.json')}
            actual['charge-resolution-reproducer'] = json.loads(run(
                [sys.executable, str(extracted / 'P9-3.3-charge-resolution-reproducer.py'),
                 '--repo', str(root)], scratch))
            actual['native_support_sources'] = {}
            for script, result_name in [('mutation_controls.py', 'mutation-controls.json'),
                                         ('characterize.py', 'numeric-characterizations.json')]:
                source = (extracted / 'p933_audit' / script).read_text()
                assert source.startswith('import bootstrap\n')
                preamble = ('import sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n'
                            f'sys.path[:0] = {[str(root / "src"), str(root), str(extracted / "p933_audit")]!r}\n'
                            'import pygrc.models.grc_v4_step as native_step\n'
                            f'assert Path(native_step.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Path({str(root)!r}))\n')
                derived = preamble + source.removeprefix('import bootstrap\n')
                target = scratch / script
                target.write_text(derived)
                actual['native_support_sources'][script] = {'original_sha256': digest(source.encode()),
                                                            'derived_source': derived, 'derived_sha256': digest(derived.encode())}
                run([sys.executable, str(target)], scratch)
                actual[result_name] = json.loads((scratch / result_name).read_text())
            assert actual['stress-results.json']['failed'] == 0
            assert len(actual['mutation-controls.json']) == 8
            assert all(r['baseline_pass'] and r['mutant_detected'] for r in actual['mutation-controls.json'])
            (output / 'actual.json').write_text(json.dumps(actual, indent=2) + '\n')
        record['source_unchanged_during_run'] = all(digest((root / p).read_bytes()) == h for p, h in hashes.items())
        assert record['source_unchanged_during_run']
        record['status'] = 'passed'
    except Exception as error:
        record['status'], record['error'] = 'failed', repr(error)
    record['completed_utc'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    record['artifacts'] = {p.name: digest(p.read_bytes()) for p in output.iterdir() if p.name != 'run.json'}
    retain()
    return int(record['status'] != 'passed')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
